_comment: The game's sound bank: every effect any fighter can play. An id names the sound, never who uses it — a state picks a variant, so giving a kick a different swing is one string, not a new definition. Numbers are append-only: swing_7 must always mean what it means today, because states.json points at it. `label` is what it sounds like, for a person reading this and for the editor's picker. Voices are not here — they belong to a fighter, in data/entities/<name>/sounds.json. Files are clips in assets/audio/sfx/; data/audio/sound-test.json says what each of the 127 is.

hit_2.label: hit landed — heavier; shares 007 until a heavier clip is named

land_2.label: a knocked-down body hitting the floor

land_3.label: the same body settling after the bounce; shares 011 with land_2

charge_1.label: charging ki — asked for every 8 frames, each copy cutting the last (as every sound does): its first 8 frames, over and over

charge_2.label: charging a beam — the kamehameha's; played once and cut off by the shot, never looped

blast_2.label: a beam leaving the hands — the kamehameha; shares 008 with burst_1
